author: "Hannah Scarbrough"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Loading Packages
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

## Global Themes 
```{r global_theme, message=FALSE}
viz_theme <- theme_classic() + 
             theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
                   legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
                   axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
                   axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"))

transparent <- theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent'),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent', color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent', color = NA),   # add color = NA
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent', color = NA))

```

## Importing Data
```{r data}
# Documents
data <- read.csv("data/s2_data_clean.csv")

# Meta-analyses
included_ma <- read.csv("data/ma_data.csv")

# Codebook 1 
s1 <- read.csv("data/s1_practice.csv")
```

## Merge Doc Type from S1
```{r merge-doc-type}
# select needed columns from S1
s1_data <- s1 %>%
  select(unique_ID, cite_country, self_cite, text_type, text_author, text_source, pub_date) %>%
  rename("unique_id" = "unique_ID") %>% 
  distinct() 

# All Document Entries
data_merge <- data %>%
  left_join(s1_data, by = "unique_id")

citations <- data_merge

unique_id <- unique(citations$unique_id)
```

```{r}
# One Row PER Document
docs <- data_merge %>% 
  distinct(unique_id, .keep_all = TRUE)   
```

## Lists of MAs by feature
```{r}
# Math
ma_math <- included_ma %>%
  filter(out_mathematics == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

# ma_math

# Reading
ma_read <- included_ma %>%
  filter(out_reading == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

# Meta-Analyses with Visualizations
ma_viz <- included_ma %>%
  filter(visualization == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

# ma_viz

# Meta-Analyses with Effect Transformations
ma_es_trans <- included_ma %>%
  filter(es_metrics == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

# ma_es_trans

# Meta-Analyses with Stakeholders
ma_stake <- included_ma %>%
  filter(stake_engagement == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id,label)

# ma_stake

# Meta-Analyses with implications
ma_imp <- included_ma %>%
  filter(section == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id,label)

# ma_imp
```

## Basic Stats
```{r pub-year}
table(docs$pub_date)

doc_year <- docs %>%
  select(pub_date) %>%
  group_by(pub_date) %>%
  count(pub_date, name = "count") %>%
  print()

doc_year_viz <- ggplot(doc_year, aes(x = pub_date, y = count)) +
  geom_col(stat = "identity", fill = "#9dc892") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust= -.5, 
            size = 3, colour = "black") +
  labs(y = "Number of Documents",
       x = "Document Publication Year") +
  theme_classic()

doc_year_viz

ggsave("visuals/doc_year_viz.png", doc_year_viz, device = "png", height = 5, width = 7)
```

```{r country}
table(docs$cite_country)

country <- docs %>%
  select(cite_country) %>%
  group_by(cite_country) %>%
  count(cite_country, name = "count") %>%
  print()

write.csv(country, "data/practice_country_table.csv")
```

```{r}
self_cite <- docs %>% 
  filter(self_cite == "Yes")

view(self_cite)
```


## Basic Visual of Type
```{r basic-type}

# calculate props
type_prop <- docs %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      text_type == "Informational - not curriculum specific" ~ "Informational - Not Curriculum Specific",
      text_type == "Promotional" ~ "Promotional",
      text_type == "Traditional research publication" ~ "Traditional Research Publication",
      text_type == "curriculum information" ~ "Curriculum Information",
      text_type == "other" ~ "Other",
      text_type == "policy document (from government source)" ~ "Policy Document - Government Source",
      text_type == "recommendation document" ~ "Recommendation Document",
      TRUE ~ text_type
    )) %>%
  count(label, name = "value") %>%
  mutate(prop = value / sum(value))

# check that prop = 1
sum(type_prop$prop)

sum(type_prop$value)

# 
type <- 
  ggplot(type_prop, aes(x = label, y = prop)) +
  geom_col(fill = "lightblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(20)) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(prop * 100, 0), "%")), vjust = -.4, 
                size = 4, family = "serif") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(legend = element_blank()) +
  labs(y = "Proportion of All Documents",
       x = "") +
  viz_theme

type
```

## Type by MA Outcome 
```{r type-by-outcome}
type_outcome_prop <- docs %>%
  select(unique_id, ma_id, text_type) %>%
  mutate(outcome = ifelse(ma_id %in% ma_read, "Reading", "Math")) %>%
  group_by(outcome, text_type) %>%
  mutate(value = 1L) %>%
  filter(text_type != "", !is.na(text_type)) %>%
  summarise(value = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>% 
  mutate(prop = value / sum(value)) %>% 
  ungroup()

type_outcome <- 
  ggplot(type_outcome_prop, aes(x = outcome, y = prop, fill = text_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_percent() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(20)) + 
  theme(legend = element_blank()) +
  viz_theme

type_outcome
```

## Basic Visual of Author
```{r basic-author}
auth_prop <- docs %>%

  group_by(text_author) %>%
```

## Basic Visual of Source
```{r basic-source}
table(docs$text_source)

source_prop <- docs %>%
  select(unique_id, text_source) %>%
  group_by(text_source) %>%
  mutate(value = 1L) %>%
  distinct(unique_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%   
  mutate(label = case_when(
    text_source == "Audio/visual media" ~ "Audio/Visual Media",
    text_source == "Curriculum website" ~ "Curriculum Website",
    text_source == "Non-profit website/Research Firm/Center" ~ "Non-Profit Website/Research Firm/Center",
    text_source == "Other government website" ~ "Other Government Website",
    text_source == "Research publication outlet" ~ "Research Publication Outlet",
    text_source == "School website" ~ "School Website",
    text_source == "State education website" ~ "State education website",
    TRUE ~ text_source)) %>%
  count(label, name = "value") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(prop = value / sum(value)) 

# check that prop = 1
sum(source_prop$prop)

sum(source_prop$value)

source <- 
  ggplot(source_prop, aes(x = label, y = prop)) +
  geom_col(fill = "lightblue") +
  scale_y_percent() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(20)) + 
  coord_flip() +
  theme(legend = element_blank()) +
  viz_theme

source
```
